auth_email_challenge_time_order.name: auth_email_challenge_time_order
auth_email_challenge_time_order.value:
"auth_email_challenges"."expires_at" > "auth_email_challenges"."created_at"
    and ("auth_email_challenges"."activated_at" is null or ("auth_email_challenges"."activated_at" >= "auth_email_challenges"."created_at" and "auth_email_challenges"."activated_at" < "auth_email_challenges"."expires_at"))
    and ("auth_email_challenges"."consumed_at" is null or "auth_email_challenges"."consumed_at" >= "auth_email_challenges"."created_at")

health_records_occurrence_shape.name: health_records_occurrence_shape
health_records_occurrence_shape.value:
case when "health_records"."record_type" in ('physical_activity_duration', 'sleep_duration')
      then "health_records"."occurred_at" is null and "health_records"."occurred_on" is not null and isfinite("health_records"."occurred_on")
      else "health_records"."occurred_on" is null and "health_records"."occurred_at" is not null and isfinite("health_records"."occurred_at")
    end

health_records_supersession_shape.name: health_records_supersession_shape
health_records_supersession_shape.value:
("health_records"."superseded_at" is null) = ("health_records"."superseded_by_record_id" is null)
    and "health_records"."supersedes_record_id" is distinct from "health_records"."id"
    and "health_records"."superseded_by_record_id" is distinct from "health_records"."id"
    and ("health_records"."supersedes_record_id" is null or "health_records"."supersedes_record_id" is distinct from "health_records"."superseded_by_record_id")

lipid_panel_finite.name: lipid_panel_finite
lipid_panel_finite.value: "lipid_panel_records"."total_cholesterol_value" not in ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') and "lipid_panel_records"."hdl_value" not in ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') and "lipid_panel_records"."ldl_value" not in ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') and "lipid_panel_records"."triglycerides_value" not in ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity')

health_document_candidate_shape.name: health_document_candidate_shape
health_document_candidate_shape.value:
case "health_document_candidates"."record_type"
      when 'blood_pressure' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" = 'mmhg'
      when 'blood_glucose' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" in ('mmol_l', 'mg_dl') and "health_document_candidates"."glucose_context" is not null
      when 'hba1c' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" = 'percent'
      when 'lipid_panel' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" in ('mmol_l', 'mg_dl')
        and num_nonnulls("health_document_candidates"."total_cholesterol_value", "health_document_candidates"."hdl_value", "health_document_candidates"."ldl_value", "health_document_candidates"."triglycerides_value") > 0
      when 'weight' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" in ('kg', 'lb')
      when 'waist_circumference' then "health_document_candidates"."candidate_value" is not null and "health_document_candidates"."second_value" is null and "health_document_candidates"."unit" in ('cm', 'in')
      else false
    end
    and ("health_document_candidates"."record_type" = 'lipid_panel' or num_nonnulls("health_document_candidates"."total_cholesterol_value", "health_document_candidates"."hdl_value", "health_document_candidates"."ldl_value", "health_document_candidates"."triglycerides_value") = 0)
    and ("health_document_candidates"."record_type" = 'blood_glucose' or "health_document_candidates"."glucose_context" is null)
